name: Blinn-Phong Shading Model
aliases: Blinn-Phong Local Illumination for Volume Rendering
definition: Computes specular reflectance using the Blinn-Phong approximation with a cosine-power lobe.
summary: The Blinn-Phong Shading Model is a local illumination technique that calculates specular highlights using a half-vector approximation, offering smoother results and lower computational cost than the standard Phong model.
